high_level_description: The image is a meme that humorously addresses a cultural detail about the animated series "Bob The Builder" in Japan. The text at the top of the image explains that in Japan, the characters from "Bob The Builder" have an "additional" fifth finger on their hands. This is because having only four fingers is considered to imply that they are a member of a sub-class or the feared mafia, the Yakuza. Below the text, there are two identical illustrations of Bob The Builder, a cartoon character.
